caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object composed of four vertical cylindrical tubes arranged parallel to each other and connected at the top and bottom by rectangular plates. The tubes and plates have a faded, bluish-gray color with visible signs of rust or oxidation indicated by brownish spots and streaks. Attached to the left side of the top section is a large, curved handle that extends downward and is also colored in the same bluish-gray with brownish markings. The base of the object features a wide, arched support that curves outward at both ends, enclosing the bottom parts of the tubes, and is mounted on four small feet. The background of the drawing is a plain, beige color with several small white speckles scattered throughout, giving a slightly aged or stained appearance.
title: Candle Mold
